content.title: City of Caney City TX
content.text: *: * Next Special Council Meeting March 26, 2025 @ 6 P.M. *:* Next Regular Council Meeting April 9, 2025 @ 6 P.M. Recent notices Welcome to the City of Caney City Caney City is a charming municipality nestled in the heart of Texas, known for its scenic beauty and tight-knit community. Situated near the shores of Cedar Creek Lake, Caney City offers a serene and picturesque setting, making it a popular destination for both residents and visitors seeking a peaceful retreat. With a focus on preserving its natural surroundings, Caney City boasts numerous outdoor recreational opportunities, including fishing, boating, and hiking, which allow residents and tourists alike to engage with the region's abundant natural beauty. The town's commitment to sustainable development and environmental stewardship underscores its dedication to maintaining its unique charm for generations to come. Notice of Public Hearings The City Council of the City of Caney City, Texas, will hold public hearings on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at 11:00 AM and on Thursday, May 14, 2026, at 6:00 PM. Both hearings will take place at the Fire Station, 15241 Barron Rd, Caney City, Texas to consider the proposed ordinance. At which time all interested persons will be given an opportunity to be heard. The hearings will consider the proposed ordinance related to regulation of short-term rentals that will amend the current zoning ordinance, 2016-02 REV.A Zoning and Related. Please contact City Hall for any Questions or requests for documentation.
